description: Shrink heavy images in place: JPEG/PNG/still GIF → WebP at the same address (no HTML change). keys = site paths from verify_page health.assets[].ref (/assets/… or clone paths like /wp-content/…), 1–50 a call. Skips animated, small and non-images (`skipped`); idempotent; originals kept (never served). Spends the daily image budget; dryRun:true reports the saving without spending it. The draft serves the smaller file at once; live after you publish (some imported files sooner).

dryRun.description: Report before/after sizes only; writes nothing and spends no budget.

keys.description: Site paths of the images, e.g. /assets/hero.jpg or /wp-content/uploads/photo.png.

name: optimize_assets
